proposal.hypothesis: Expanded joint range cannot help if the rise phase interpolates back to an upright stance while the torso is inverted. A contact-seeking brace should use the same four feet, 1.2 rad abduction travel, and a bounded inverted-only target until two feet regain support.
proposal.expectedEffect: Turn the observed zero-support inverted plateau into a two-foot support event, then allow the existing waist and phased recovery to continue without changing locomotion commands.
